Actual facial surface target: Buddha head by peel-3d.com, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/buddha-head-fb17c123ad9c4c0fb6baf723b3fffd79 , CC BY4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Donor culture/period unspecified; not claimed Japanese. Modifications: real3D BVH ray-triangle surface retarget onto NC connected topology, 99% core donor hit plus1% source regularization, broad smooth neck/temple/scalp transition; knownR05 curl relief removed and bounded source cap cage. Originals retained unchanged. No endorsement implied. Combined adaptation/imagery retains NC-SA4.0; original donor remains CC BY4.0. R06f additionally fairs a measured 3D source scalp radial field, with compact anisotropic deformation of existing scalp and restrained Taubin fairing of actual head triangles; no synthetic head replacement. R06g fairs the actual inherited scalp ridge with 300 pinned-boundary Laplacian steps and reduces lower-cheek scan chatter with 60 Taubin pairs. R06h carves fine shallow spiral curl relief directly into the same continuous scalp; sampled original scalp vertex roots and tangent frames retained. R06j, after rejecting I for excessive ear/jaw smoothing, repositions the anterior ear attachment posteriorly and inward, preserves the ear bowl/rim through smooth anchors, and blends side-cheek/jaw curvature with gentler connected-mesh fairing. Actual donor eyelid/nose/lip cores and all body positions below Y2.15 remain exact. Ear attachment is a declared reshaped derivative. R08a rejects the R07 donor-cheek transplant and retains the entire uncut continuous J/NC face. Conforming refinement adds source-supported feature detail; actual saved donor triangle/barycentric targets and exact closest points on neighboring source triangles guide bounded eye/brow/nose/lip geometry, without transplanting the donors worn cheeks. Existing source ears turn coherently, with direct original-NC triangle/barycentric ancestry. Actual irregular coil roots and raised curls are sculpted on the connected scalp; standard aged-gold vertex color keeps the original metalness/roughness/roughnessMap. Original inputs and all rejected candidates remain.
rejectedAlternative: R07 direct donor-face patch remained visible despite tangent repair; it is frozen and not used here.

continuousRefinement.method: One shared-edge red/green refinement of the intact NC/J face, true feature regions and source scalp; no cut-out facial patch.

actualFeatureFit.method: Real saved donor triangle/barycentric correspondence for original J vertices; new feature midpoint targets are exact closest points on the actual adjacent donor triangles. Bounded C2 feature displacement on the intact NC face; no donor cheek transplant or image projection.

earTurn.method: Small continuous rotation of the actual inherited NC ear volume toward the front, with broad root/lobe blend; no sharpening or relief amplification.

rootedCurls.method: Raised one-turn coil ridges and rounded rooted volumes on the same source scalp. First-row roots use actual source-surface vertices with irregular height/spacing; material coverage follows their 3D footprints. No cut spiral pits or straight analytic cap edge.

normalTreatment: One continuous source normal field is interpolated through conforming refinement; only the geometric normal change caused by actual feature/ear/curl sculpt is added. No source-region face normal switch. Body normals belowY2.15 exact from J.

bodyPreservation.source: All original J/R05 vertices belowY2.15 retain IDs and exact positions/normals.

coverage.format: CM07 uint16 normalized actual 3D root footprint coverage.

scalpMaterial.implementation: Standard vertexColors, original metalness/roughness/roughnessMap unchanged; current native exporter and physical importer support sourceColor.

midpoints.format: 20-byte MP08 header originalJVertices,newMidpointCount,recordBytes8; then uint32 parentA,parentB for each appended vertex. Each pair refers to the intact J source vertices.

triangles.format: 20-byte TP08 header triangleCount,recordBytes4; uint32 original J triangle per output triangle.

features.format: 20-byte FT08 header vertices,recordCount,bytes28; uint32 outputVertex,donorComponentTriangle; float32 barycentric3,appliedWeight,actualDeltaLength. These are true3D source targets, not inserted donor triangles.

ears.format: 20-byte ER07 header count,bytes24; uint32 outputVertex,originalNC triangle; float32 originalNC barycentric3; reserved4.

roots.format: CR07 header and64-byte original-surface root/tangent records.

limits: Actual anatomy/likeness and surface transitions need genuine front/3q/both-profile inspection.
Integrity facts do not establish photographic fidelity or self-intersection freedom.
Feature mapping is a bounded declared derivative guided by real source triangles; donor cheeks/side hair are not transplanted.
No physical render, Blender, scene export, canonical/shared/Git mutation or child agent.

replaySeed.format: 20-byte CD08 header originalJCount,recordCount,recordBytes28,version1; records uint32 Jvertex,float64 XYZ(H-G). Subtract from J positions before conforming refinement. Exact float64 differences, no image input.

preflightNormalReferenceCorrection.scope: Superseded before any native frame. Both exact versions remain reconstructible; no failed rendered source is deleted.
preflightNormalReferenceCorrection.recovery: Gunzip current geometry, XOR this decoded delta into its normal block, then gzip level7 to recover the exact earlier compressed bytes.
